name: deckfall
title: Deckfall
description: A stack of cards swiped away one at a time, with the cards behind rising into place.

perf.budget: Only visible cards (plus one) are mounted. Dragging updates two shared values on the UI thread; each card evaluates one style worklet.

a11y.reducedMotion: No tilt or vertical drift; a swiped card fades out quickly instead of flying away.
a11y.screenReader: Only the top card is exposed, with 'swipe left' and 'swipe right' actions named by leftLabel/rightLabel. Other cards are hidden.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add deckfall`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
